query: Before I sign, I want to check that the routeXdr I got back really enforces the minimum output the quote promised. How do I inspect it?
expected_behavior: Decodes `routeXdr` as a base64 ScVal (`scValToNative(xdr.ScVal.fromXDR(quote.routeXdr, 'base64'))`) into the `StrategyPayload` map `{ amounts: i128[], assets: Address[], ops: Bytes }`, not as raw program bytes or a TransactionEnvelope

Reads the min-out as an index: header byte `ops[3]` (MIN_OUT) indexes `amounts`, so the check is `BigInt(amounts[ops[3]]) === BigInt(quote.amountOutMin)`, never interpreting byte 3 itself as the amount

Knows the header layout for VERSION 1: [0]=version, [1]=tokenIn index, [2]=tokenOut index, [3]=minOut amounts index, [4..8]=u32 BE referral id, [8]=op count, [9]=weight count; then 5-byte instruction records (opcode, mode, pool, tokenIn, tokenOut) and 3-byte u24 ppm split weights

Verifies the standalone envelope invokes `execute_strategy(sender, total_in, swap_xdr)` with args[2] bytes equal to `routeXdr` and `total_in` equal to the quote's gross `amountIn` (fee-inclusive), rather than net-of-fee or `amountOut`

Does not tell the user to `transfer` or `approve` tokens to the router first: the router pulls the input under the sender's own `require_auth` (measured delta, `transfer_amount_measured`) and self-authorizes venue calls, so the only auth is the sender's signature on the invocation

Uses the server's `routeXdr` as-is for execution (`buildStellarExecuteStrategyTx({ routeXdr })` / `mapQuoteResponseToStrategySwap`) instead of re-encoding a payload from `hops`/`paths` with `mapQuoteResponseToStrategyPayload`, which loses the server-chosen referral and split weights

Simulates the sequence-populated transaction and checks `scValToNative(simulation.result.retval) >= amountOutMin`; explains a shortfall at execution reverts with router error `SlippageExceeded = 5`, mapped by contract id (router errors and controller errors share numeric codes)
machine_checkable: Generated code contains `ops[3]` (or an equivalently named MIN_OUT index constant equal to 3) used as an index into `amounts`
Generated code contains no call to token `approve` or `transfer` targeting the router address before `execute_strategy`
